I build AI systems and see them through — from first experiment to production. Five years across enterprise GenAI and ML: I currently lead and mentor a 5-person data-science team in Uber's AI org (via Indium), shipping document intelligence, multi-agent RAG copilots, and LLM fine-tuning pipelines — including a document-understanding transformer pretrained on 50M+ documents that displaced manual review for $10M+ in annual savings.
